title: SOC triage verdict v1
description: Structured output required from jarvis-soc-l1 and jarvis-soc-l2 via LiteLLM response_format. Replaces free-text parsing in n8n. proposed_actions items use the SAME capability/target vocabulary as contracts/api/core-request.v1.schema.json#/$defs/action so a verdict can be forwarded to Core's action endpoint without translation.

justification.description: Technical justification citing concrete log/context data. No text outside this schema is accepted.

proposed_actions.description: Each item is a candidate Core action. It is NEVER auto-executed: n8n forwards it to Core as kind="action", where PolicyEngine + the (currently disabled) RestrictedExecutor decide, exactly like any other action request.

target.description: Agent/host identifier, matching core-request.v1 target pattern.

tuning_suggestion.description: Optional: suggested rule tuning to reduce future false positives. Informational only, never auto-applied.
